entities.name: Assad
entities.description: A naive, eager fifteen-year-old Fallaji replacement soldier fighting for Mishra at the Argivian Front.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Desert tribes from which Assad hails.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Leader on whose side Assad fought in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Argivian Front
entities.description: Front where Assad arrived as a replacement.

entities.name: Argivians

events.summary: Assad arrives at the Argivian Front, confident and eager, contrasting with the war-weary veterans.
events.quote: Assad stood out as confident and eager, despite his inexperience

events.summary: Assad takes part in the Tomakul Campaign with no prior combat experience.
events.quote: Assad participated in the Tomakul Campaign .

events.summary: Veterans planning a covert escape distrust Assad as too naive and impulsive.
events.quote: he was not considered trustworthy by the experienced soldiers when they planned a covert escape

relations.quote: Assad was a Fallaji soldier who fought on the side of Mishra in the Brothers' War .
He was vocal about his desire to attack the Argivians
